name: fineprint-agent
description: FinePrint Agent — grounded money-loss stipulation scanner (CEN 4930 Team DNK)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @fineprint/shared && npm run build -w @fineprint/mcp-document && npm run build -w @fineprint/mcp-mailbox && npm run build -w @fineprint/agent && npm run build -w @fineprint/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fineprint/shared && npm run build -w @fineprint/mcp-document && npm run build -w @fineprint/mcp-mailbox && npm run build -w @fineprint/agent && npm run dev -w @fineprint/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @fineprint/shared && npm run build -w @fineprint/mcp-document && npm run build -w @fineprint/mcp-mailbox && npm run build -w @fineprint/agent && node --import tsx --test tests/**/*.test.ts
scripts.mcp:rebuild: npm run build -w @fineprint/shared && npm run build -w @fineprint/mcp-document && npm run build -w @fineprint/mcp-mailbox
